spec_text_or_path: A melee/AoE loop whose damage output is sourced FROM a defensive stat (armor), not from weapon/skill scaling. TQ2 Bastion: Shield Attack 'overwrites damage source to current armor'; Armor Eruption 'converts all current armor into area-of-effect damage' (two instances). The player stacks armor via Ironclad (MAX) to hit HARDER, so armor is simultaneously the durability AND the damage substrate. The engine resource_economy/trait lanes scale damage off skill/weapon/element -- there is NO lane where a DEFENSIVE stat (armor value) becomes/overwrites the damage source. §E ruling (FLAG 11): this is a DISTINCT stat-as-damage-substrate mechanism from docket #4 stun-as-damage -- file as its OWN candidate, do NOT merge. Kit graded APPROX un-minted (normal skill scaling approximates the output; the armor-coupling is the identity gap).

mechanism_class: reserved-resource AS damage-scaler (reservation coupling to damage magnitude)
spec_text_or_path: A skill whose damage SCALES WITH the amount of a resource kept RESERVED. TQ2 Stormblade Ice Shards: '9 shards ... scaling damage with reserved energy' -- the player reserves energy and the reserved amount pumps Ice Shards' per-hit damage. The engine resource_economy has reservation keys (reservation_percent/flat: reserve a resource, typically to pay for an aura/toggle) but NONE where the RESERVED quantity is an INPUT to the skill's damage magnitude -- 'reserve more to hit harder' has no lane. §E watch-item (FLAG 10): if no economy key expresses the coupling, file docket-candidate. reservation_percent was set in mapping_json with a fidelity_note as the nearest surface, and the coupling is docketed here for steward consolidation. Kit graded APPROX un-minted (reservation exists; reservation-as-damage-scaler does not).

mechanism_class: throw-retrieve finite-payload reload (spent-ammo you must physically collect to rearm)
spec_text_or_path: A finite-ammo skill where spent projectiles do NOT auto-replenish -- the player must perform a SECOND action (a lunge/dash) to physically RETRIEVE the thrown payloads and reload. Hades2 Medea Skull (Revaal): 'The Skull throws shells that explode on hit, and the special is a lunge that retrieves them' (FLAG 5 -- retrieve is a second ACTION, not auto-return). Two coupled gaps: (a) the OUT-AND-RETURN projectile path is accrued to the spectral-throw/boomerang family (see mint-candidates-batch-04, existing qualitative mint class); (b) the FINITE-PAYLOAD-RELOAD ECONOMY -- an ammo pool that ONLY refills by a retrieval action, coupling the reload to a mobility/evasion commitment (the lunge is also the graze/evasion tool) -- has no engine ammo/economy lane (engine ammo refills on time/kill, never on a go-collect-your-spent-shells action). The retrieval-reload rhythm (throw-out, dash-back-into-the-pack-to-rearm) IS the kit's identity. Kit graded APPROX->MAPPED_DOCKET.
